_about: OCR model sets of task ocr-any (ocr_any_task.py). name -> CRNN model dirs under models/ (in voting order: the first 'stage1' models are the cascade's stage 1 when hints exist), env switches of eciocr/prod/eci_ocr.py (all set explicitly, so the provenance is exact), hints mode ('required': the item must carry a hints key; 'none': run without hints even when the item has some; 'optional'), and the gold results at adoption. A new set = one entry here + its model dirs (crnn.onnx + charset.json) committed; sha256_16 / charset_sha256_16 = first 16 hex chars of the sha256 of crnn.onnx / charset.json (both checked by the task before the first item). FROZEN ONCE DEPLOYED: after the first item of a set has run on the pool, its entry (models, sha256_16, env, stage1) is never changed; a change is a new set (new name), so ocr_model_set + ocr_code name the exact rules and models of every record (model_sha256_16 is only in the part summary). The sets below are not deployed yet (2026-11-25 ocrv5 review fixes went into v4a before the first run). Every set names every eci_ocr decision switch (ECI_* read by eciocr/prod and eciocr/ocr), also those without effect for its hints mode; ECI_RESCALE_H and ECI_DIGIT_CRNN are listed with the values that are the code defaults ('' = off). ocr-any removes every other ECI_* variable; only ECI_OCR_WORKERS and ECI_TESS_CLI pass (speed / call path); ECI_CRNN is only the default when no --crnn is given (ocr-any always gives them). Review 3 (2026-11-25, before any deploy): ECI_CODE_VALID=1 and ECI_PARTNO_LIST=1 added to every set (see eci_ocr.post_rules). formocr (2026-11-25): set j5r4 for the form-route rolls; 'aux' lists further files under models/ that the env names as <models>/NAME (checked like the models). Switches added to the code after a set was frozen (the job2 / job5 NOHINT_*, EPIC_STATE, PAREN_GUARD, CONFW_SKIP) are not in the older sets: ocr-any removes every other ECI_* variable, so for those sets they stay at their code default (off).
